content: Yesu ꞌina lohatoto ꞌana tomuliyao site tuwelo ꞌoidiya ꞌilosalohiya, ma ꞌoinega tupwaina ꞌiꞌebesineya ma ꞌisakowasiya ꞌasaedi ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya, ꞌiheꞌita ma ꞌilolohatoto.
Yoni toꞌabihebabitaiso Yesu tetelina ꞌihesagoheya
Tuta nage ꞌoina Yoni toꞌabihebabitaiso deliya silagu pwaiya, ma Toꞌabihetenaina ꞌina paihowa tetelina ꞌihesagoheya, ma ꞌoinega ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌihesumanediya ta sitauya Yesu ꞌoina,
ma sihesilaleya, sigwae, “Togidega ꞌowa Toꞌabihetenaina weyahiu ꞌayamwayamwa, bo hali loheya ꞌayamwayamwa?”
Ta ꞌidi gwae Yesu ꞌihemaiseya, ꞌigwae, “Wahila ma Yoni ꞌoina waheꞌoteꞌotetela ginauledi ꞌoiguwega wahesagoheya, ma wete waꞌitediya,

tomata gibugibu matadi ꞌitayahala pwaiya, toheꞌauꞌau sibwebweꞌana pwaiya ta sitautauya, tolepelo wahidi sibwebweꞌana hila, totenatuitui gwae sihehesagohe, toꞌamasa sitoholo hila, ma wete tohewewelohe tetela bwebweꞌana sihesagohe pwaiya.
Coinega watauya ma Yoni wahegwae ma sahena weyahigu ꞌihehenuwanaluwa, weyahina ꞌeguma taiya ꞌina hemisa weyahigu geya ꞌiweꞌa, tauna ꞌiyaliyaya.”

Eeta Yoni ꞌana tomuliyaowedi sihila, ma Yesu ꞌiꞌahwa lalagata ma boda ꞌoidiya Yoni weyahina ꞌihepwaila ꞌigwaeya, “Mwalo mabwaiyami tupwa balabala ꞌawawa watauya Yoni sabi hesagohaina, ma toꞌaha nuwanuwami ma ꞌabehega waꞌita? Cemi nuwanuwami ꞌabehega ꞌaigeda pwatula sinabwana yaumai ꞌinihunihuwe waꞌita?
“Bo nuwana ꞌaigeda loheya ma ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo wasawasa sabi ꞌitaina? Bo geya, weyahina taudi ma ꞌadi ꞌaleꞌo wasawasa toloina madoudi ꞌidi tupwa simiyamiya.
“Ma toꞌaha hede weyahina ta watauya balabala ꞌawawa? Nuwana ꞌabehega wanuwatuhuya nata palopita ꞌaigeda waꞌita ꞌawa? Moisa, loheyaina waꞌiteya palopitao ꞌimadou sinediya.
Yoniina weyahina mwalo Yehoba ꞌina gwae Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina bewa gide ꞌihepwaila nugeteya, ꞌigwae, ‘Bewa ꞌigu tohalewasa yahesumane matauwa ꞌitautauya, ma ꞌino ꞌeda ꞌihuna.’”
Ta Yesu wete ꞌigwae, “Moisa, Yoni toꞌabihebabitaiso tauna mebaleꞌu mabwaiyadi ꞌimadou sinediya, ma hesi mabwaiyadi taudi Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌalona Yoni simadou sineya.
“Tuta Yoni ꞌina ꞌabihebabitaiso ꞌoinega ma nige, tomota sitohotoho waiwai ma ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina siluhu, ma tohewaiwaiyedi taudi ꞌidi waiwaiyega siluhu.
Mwalo palopitao mabwaiyadi ꞌidi gwaeyao ma Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌoidiyega gwae hemisa sigwae nugeta eeta ꞌana laba Yoni ꞌitauyama.
Ma ꞌeguma nuwanuwami ma wanuwasabwalena Yoni weyahina, wada sanapu ꞌabehega tauna tuwa Ilaitiyaina weyahina wayamwayamwa.
“Coinega ꞌeguma taiya matenana gwae bewa ꞌihesagohedi.
“Comi boda ꞌehaumi togidega yagwae hegehegedi ꞌesa weyahimi? Nuwana yagwae ꞌomi gide tuwa gwagwama ꞌebe maketi ꞌalona siꞌeꞌeheyaheyale, ma ꞌiyadiyao ꞌoidiya sibwaubwau sigwae,

content.text: ‘Ciyamayao, togidega ꞌiya ta ꞌalahulahusa ma geya wada sobuwa! Ma wete ꞌadou gwaegwae ma geya wada douwa!’

content: “Gwae hegehegediyedi ꞌana nuwasabwalena ꞌabehega Yoni ꞌinaoma ma geya ꞌiꞌai ma geya ꞌinuma, ma ꞌoinega wagwae ꞌabehega hiꞌahiꞌa Yoni ꞌiꞌabi hebuweya!

Ma taugu Loheyaiguina yanaoma ma yaꞌaiꞌai ma yanumanuma, ma wete weyahigu walolomugi, wagwaegwae, ‘Loheyaina toꞌai ma tonuma hedahedade, ma topui takesi ꞌana toꞌewao ma topui baibaiwadi ꞌiheꞌiyaꞌiyaguwedi.’ “Ma taudi tosanapu moisa ꞌabwa ꞌidi paihowa bwebweꞌadi ꞌoidiyega sanapu moisa ꞌilatulatu.”
Tupwadi ꞌasa galadi ꞌabwa yatala siloba.
Coinega Yesu ꞌasaedi ꞌina paihowa waiwaidi siꞌiteya, ma geya sinuwabui ꞌidi puiyao ꞌoidiyega, taudi ꞌiheheliyediya, ꞌigwaeya,

“Comi meKolasini ma meBedeseida ꞌatemuyamuyaimi hesi. Weyahina ꞌebe henainaidaedi yapaihowa pwaidiya ꞌoimiya, ma hesi geya wanuwabui. Ma hesi ꞌeguma meTaiya ma meSaidoni ꞌoidiya yada paihowediya, beno mwalo hene sida nuwabuiya, ma sibasibauwa ꞌadi ꞌaleꞌo sida ꞌotedi ma giba ꞌoidiyega sida gibadi ma sida heꞌitaedi ꞌabehega ꞌidi mumuga galadi ꞌoidiyega sinuwabui pwaiya.
Ma hesi ꞌomi geya, ꞌoinega yatala ꞌana sabwelo ꞌoina nata Yehoba meTaiya ma meSaidoni ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyedi, ma ꞌomi sahena.

“Ma ꞌomi meKapaneumi togidega? Cabehega taumimo waꞌabilagasigomi galewa, ꞌawa? Geya hene! Ma hesi nata Bwebweso ꞌalona siula dobihegomi. Weyahina ꞌebe henainaidaedi yapaihowa pwaidiya ꞌoimiya ma hesi geya wanuwabui, ma mwalo ꞌeguma meSodoma ꞌoidiya yada paihoweya, mwalo hene sida nuwabuiya, ma ꞌane Yehoba sahena ꞌimutumutudi, ma nige ꞌidi ꞌasa ꞌida miyamiya.
Coinega yatala ꞌana sabwelo ꞌoina Yehoba nata meSodoma ꞌiꞌatemuyemuyedi, ma ꞌomi sahena.”
Caiyawasi Yesu ꞌoinega
Tuta nage ꞌoina Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Yauwedo Tamagu, ꞌowa galewa ma baleꞌu ꞌadi toloina, sanapu bewa ꞌudahweya tosonogao ma tonuwasabwalenao ꞌoidiyega, ma hesi gwagwama ꞌiꞌiudi ꞌoidiya ꞌuheꞌitaeya.
Moisa Tamagu, ꞌino nuwatuhu bewa ꞌausala.”

Ma wete ꞌigwaeya, “Ginaula mabwaiyana Tamagu nimaguwa ꞌilagu pwaidiya ma Tamaguina taboinamo ꞌisanapugauwa, ma taugu wete Tamagu taugumo yasanapuya, ma wete ꞌeguma taiyawedi taudi nuwanuwagu ma Tamagu yaheꞌitae ꞌoidiya, taudi wete sisanapu.
“Ma ꞌoinega ꞌomi ꞌimi paihowa mwauna, wanaoma ꞌoiguwa, ma yaꞌabihe ꞌaiyawasigomi.
Ma ꞌomi waheꞌauꞌaunawegau ma maꞌiyagwao tapaihowa, ma ꞌoinega yaluyaluwami ꞌidi ꞌaiyawasi siloba, weyahina taugu ꞌigu mumuga nuhana ma tonuwasulu.
Coinega paihowaedi ma ꞌahaꞌahalaedi yaꞌebwaegomi meyameyahana.”
